one_liner: Cloud communications platform for building SMS, voice, messaging, and authentication features into applications.
access_notes: Sign up for a free self-serve account or trial to get credentials; paid usage requires a billing plan.
verdict_reason: Fully documented public REST APIs and SDKs with self-serve account creation and an official MCP server.

evidence.snippet: API Keys — Recommended for server-side apps
Sign up for a free Twilio account and grab one of our official server-side SDKs to get started.
The server is hosted by Twilio at `mcp.twilio.com/docs`—point your IDE at the URL.
